messages:
Alice: FYI customer report — invoke API returning 400 schema validation. They sent a legacy SDK payload with an extra top-level `meta` object and numbers for prices. Error text in their response: \"Additional properties are not allowed ('meta' was unexpected)\". Repro below.
Ben: can you paste the raw request headers + body (omit secrets) so we can triage?
Alice: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-open-3b\",\"tool\":\"invoice/parse\",\"input\":\"...\",\"meta\":{\"origin\":\"legacy-sdk\",\"debug\":true},\"lineitems\":[{\"description\":\"consulting\",\"unit_price\":100,\"quantity\":1}] }'
Carla: quick context — invoice/parse v1 accepted additionalProperties and coerced ints to strings for unit_price. v2 has `additionalProperties: false` on the root and enforces `lineitems[].unit_price` as string. Legacy SDK started injecting `meta` and some customers still send ints.
Alice: customer sees two different errors depending on routing: either the additionalProperties 400 OR a required field `billing_profile.id` missing. Their logs show both in separate attempts.
Dan: router note — when capacity is tight we sometimes route to `invoice/parse:v2-strict` as a fallback variant. That would explain stricter failures. I can reproduce locally by forcing variant header.
Ben: can we confirm the router selection traces for this customer's requests? Need to know if fallback kicked in.
Alice: trace id 8f7a3c in their logs shows variant=v2-strict.
Carla: OK. Options: ask customer to upgrade SDK quickly (not ideal), relax v2 schema (bad for regressions), or implement a targeted shim in the gateway to accept legacy payload shapes.
Dan: recommended short-term: router shim for `invoice/parse` that strips unknown top-level keys (like `meta`) and coerces numeric `lineitems.*.unit_price` -> string. I'll implement a canary.
Ben: I'll add a gateway transform rule scoped to tool=invoice/parse + tenant whitelist. No global schema loosening.
Alice: customer wants ETA. Can we get a 3-hour canary?
infra-bot: deploy started: canary/router-shim-invoiceparse sha=abc123 env=canary
Ben: monitoring 3xx/4xx/5xx and validation errors now.
Dan: pushed shim, running local repro — it converts 100 -> \"100\" and drops `meta`. Reprobed against canary, 200 returned.
Carla: after canary passes, we should add a telemetry counter for how often legacy payloads arrive so we can plan a more robust SDK migration path.
Alice: filed customer update: \"We found a targeted fix; canary is live, ETA ~3h for full rollout. If you can avoid SDK changes for now we'll handle it server-side\"
Ben: noted. Will escalate to eng-sre if we see errors spike.
Alice: thanks all. Closing the loop with customer once rollout is complete. :thumbsup:
